headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title_en: Two departments: By 2030, the share of large modern coal mines' capacity nationwide will rise to 87%
headlines.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and the National Energy Administration (NEA) issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that by 2030, coal's role as a fallback guarantee will be further strengthened, production and development layouts will be continuously optimized, the share of high-quality advanced capacity will rise, and the production-supply-storage-sales system will be more complete, with large modern coal mines accounting for 87% of capacity. Safe, green development and clean, efficient utilization will notably improve; full-system intelligent construction will advance, with intelligent coal mines reaching 75% of capacity. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, dynamic supply-demand balancing mechanisms will improve, industry modernization governance will significantly strengthen, a modern coal industry system will be basically completed, and high-quality development will reach a new level.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场 完善基础制度和规则
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，持续推进现代煤炭市场建设，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Actively develop a unified national coal trading market and improve foundational systems and rules
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It calls for continued development of a modern coal market, actively building a unified national coal trading market, improving basic systems and rules, enhancing information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the national coal trading center. It also includes improving the medium- and long-term contract system for coal power supply guarantees, standardizing coal trading contracts, strengthening contract signing and performance supervision, refining the coal market price formation mechanism, adjusting price range control policies based on market conditions and cost changes, and regulating price index behavior.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：加快煤炭产业结构优化升级，推动落后无效产能退出
headlines.summary: 金十期货8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，推动落后无效产能退出。坚持先立后破，统筹煤矿关闭退出与区域供应保障，按照市场化法治化原则，推动落后产能煤矿有序退出。西部地区优化生产结构，加快淘汰技术装备差、与生态敏感区重叠煤矿。东中部地区稳妥推进灾害严重不能有效治理、资源枯竭煤矿退出，妥善做好遗留问题处置和职工安置。西南、东北等地区因地制宜设置政策标准，合理引导资源条件差、安全保障程度低的中小煤矿退出，运用政策引导、市场手段等加快推动长期停产停建煤矿应退尽退。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Accelerate the optimization and upgrading of the coal industry structure, and promote the exit of outdated and ineffective capacity
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Futures, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that the phase-out of backward and inefficient capacity will be promoted. Adhering to the principle of 'establishing the new before abolishing the old,' the plan coordinates coal mine closures with regional supply guarantees, and under market-based and rule-of-law principles, promotes the orderly exit of outdated coal mines. The western region will optimize production structures, accelerating the elimination of mines with poor equipment or overlapping ecologically sensitive areas. The central and eastern regions will steadily phase out mines with severe, unmanageable disasters or depleted resources, properly handling legacy issues and worker resettlement. The southwest, northeast and other regions will set policy standards tailored to local conditions, guide the exit of small and medium mines with poor resource conditions or low safety levels, and use policy guidance and market measures to accelerate the exit of long-term suspended mines.

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: By 2030, coal's role in ensuring basic security will be further strengthened
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' The plan adheres to principles of bottom-line thinking and safety as the foundation, clean efficiency and green low-carbon, innovation-driven industrial upgrading, market orientation and efficiency enhancement, and people-first integrated development. By 2030, coal's fallback guarantee capacity will be further strengthened, production and development layouts will be optimized, the share of high-quality advanced capacity will rise, the production-supply-storage-sales system will be more complete, with large modern coal mines accounting for 87% of capacity. Safe, green development and clean, efficient utilization will notably improve; intelligent construction will advance across the system, with intelligent coal mines reaching 75% of capacity. A coal-based diversified industrial pattern will take shape faster, coal consumption will peak, dynamic supply-demand balancing mechanisms will improve, and industry modernization governance will significantly strengthen.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: Shanghai Composite Index rises 0.67%, marking 5 consecutive gains; pharmaceutical and consumer stocks rally
headlines.summary_en: The market fluctuated with mixed trends throughout the day, with the three major indices ending mixed. Consumer stocks like food rallied, with Huangshi Group, Xiangpiaopiao, and Yiming Food hitting limit-up. Pharmaceutical stocks extended gains, with Baihua Pharma hitting 5 consecutive limit-ups, and Yatai Pharmaceutical, Hayao Group and others also rising to limit-up. Gold stocks fluctuated higher, with Zhaojin Gold, CHJ Jewellery, and Mankaron hitting limit-up. The military sector performed actively, with Hongdu Aviation, Hunan Tianyan, and Great Wall Military rising to limit-up. On the downside, computing hardware stocks like PCB and CPO fell, with Taijin New Energy down over 8%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 4,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets higher, and turnover near RMB 2.54 trillion. By close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.67%, the Shenzhen Component Index gained 0.04%, and the ChiNext Index fell 0.73%.

headlines.title_en: Morning close on August 10: ChiNext Index drops over 2% in half-day trading; pharmaceutical and consumer stocks buck the trend
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market showed clear divergence early, with the Shanghai Composite in positive territory but the ChiNext Index down over 2%. Pharmaceutical stocks extended gains, with Baihua Pharma hitting 5 consecutive limit-ups, and Yatai Pharmaceutical, Ha Sanlian, Haisco Pharmaceutical and others rising to limit-up. Food and other consumer stocks rallied against the trend, with Huangshi Group, Xiangpiaopiao, and Yiming Food hitting limit-up. The military sector moved higher, with Hunan Tianyan and Great Wall Military rising to limit-up. On the downside, PCB, CPO and other computing hardware stocks fell, with Accelink Technologies near limit-down, and Changyingtong and Taijin New Energy down over 10%. More stocks rose than fell, with over 3,400 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets higher, and morning turnover at RMB 1.75 trillion. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.2%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.13%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.18%. 2. By sector, military, pharma, consumer, and pork led gains; CPO, glass substrates, PCB, and 6G led losses. 3. Across the two exchanges, 3,253 stocks rose.

headlines.title: 《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》印发：2030年 五大煤炭供应保障基地产量占全国比重超80%
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，统筹资源开发条件、市场需求、运输通道、环境约束等因素，有序推进煤炭资源开发。西部资源富集地区强化开发整体规划，完善上下游开发利用体系，提升跨区域协同保障能力。持续推进山西、蒙西、蒙东、陕北、新疆煤炭供应保障基地建设，高标准规划建设一批大型现代化煤矿，提升规模化集约化开发水平，2030年，五大煤炭供应保障基地产量占全国比重超80%。东中部地区统筹本地区用能需求，合理控制开发节奏，根据资源条件加强评估论证，适度建设接续煤矿。

headlines.title_en: '15th Five-Year Plan' for Coal Industry Development issued: By 2030, output from the five major coal supply guarantee bases will account for over 80% of the national total
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that coal resource development will proceed in an orderly manner, taking into account resource development conditions, market demand, transport corridors, and environmental constraints. Resource-rich western regions will strengthen overall development planning, improve upstream-downstream development systems, and enhance cross-regional coordinated supply capabilities. The construction of coal supply guarantee bases in Shanxi, western Inner Mongolia, eastern Inner Mongolia, northern Shaanxi, and Xinjiang will continue, with a batch of large modern coal mines planned and built to high standards to improve large-scale, intensive development. By 2030, output from these five major bases will account for over 80% of national production. The central and eastern regions will coordinate local energy demand, reasonably control development pace, strengthen assessment based on resource conditions, and appropriately build replacement mines.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：加强负面清单管理，原则上停止新建、改扩建不符合条件煤矿
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加强负面清单管理，原则上停止新建、改扩建以下煤矿：山西、内蒙古、陕西、新疆（除南疆外）产能低于120万吨/年的煤矿，宁夏产能低于60万吨/年的煤矿，其他地区产能低于30万吨/年的煤矿。停止新建产能低于90万吨/年的煤与瓦斯突出、冲击地压、水文地质类型极复杂的煤矿。停止新建第一水平开采深度超1000米和改扩建开采深度超1200米的煤矿，停止新建和改扩建开采深度超过600米的小型煤矿。禁止在生态保护红线、自然保护地、饮用水水源保护区等生态敏感区内规划新建煤矿。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Strengthen negative list management, and in principle stop the construction and expansion of coal mines that do not meet conditions
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that negative list management will be strengthened, with new construction or expansion of the following mines essentially halted: mines with capacity below 12 million tonnes/year in Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, and Xinjiang (excluding southern Xinjiang); mines with capacity below 6 million tonnes/year in Ningxia; and mines with capacity below 3 million tonnes/year in other regions. New construction of coal and gas outburst, rock burst, or extremely complex hydrogeological mines with capacity below 9 million tonnes/year will be halted. New mines with first-level mining depth exceeding 1,000 meters and expansions exceeding 1,200 meters will be stopped, as will new or expanded small mines with mining depth exceeding 600 meters. New coal mines in ecologically sensitive areas such as ecological red lines, nature reserves, and drinking water source protection zones will be prohibited.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：到2030年 煤层气产量260亿立方米 瓦斯利用量65亿立方米
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委国家能源局有关负责同志就《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》答记者问。开发利用煤层气具有保障煤矿安全生产、增加清洁能源供应、减少温室气体排放等多重效益。为加快推进煤层气勘探开发、煤矿瓦斯抽采利用，按照既往工作惯例，专门编制《煤层气开发利用方案》作为规划附件。《方案》提出四个方面重点任务。在煤层气勘探开发方面，推动沁水盆地煤层气产业基地稳产增产，推进鄂尔多斯盆地东部煤层气产业基地快速上产，加快新疆煤层气产业化发展，积极拓展其他资源开发区域。在煤矿瓦斯抽采利用方面，深化煤炭与煤矿瓦斯共采，强化煤矿瓦斯全浓度利用，稳步推进煤炭行业

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: By 2030, coalbed methane output will reach 26 billion cubic meters, and gas utilization will reach 6.5 billion cubic meters
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: Relevant officials from the NDRC and NEA answered questions about the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' Developing and utilizing coalbed methane has multiple benefits, including ensuring coal mine safety, increasing clean energy supply, and reducing greenhouse gas emissions. To accelerate CBM exploration and development and coal mine gas extraction and utilization, following past practices, a dedicated 'Coalbed Methane Development and Utilization Plan' was compiled as an annex. The plan proposes four key tasks. In CBM exploration and development, it promotes stable production and output increases in the Qinshui Basin CBM industrial base, rapid production ramp-up in the eastern Ordos Basin CBM base, faster industrialization in Xinjiang, and expansion into other resource areas. In coal mine gas extraction and utilization, it deepens co-mining of coal and CBM, strengthens full-concentration gas utilization, and steadily advances the coal industry.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：积极推进煤炭法修订 完善煤炭行业标准（MT）体系
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，积极推进煤炭法修订，完善煤炭行业标准（MT）体系。强化 煤炭矿区总体规划管理，严格落实矿区总体规划确定的开发方案， 提高资源集约高效开发水平。加强产能“一本账”管理，适时调整 完善产能置换政策，强化产能登记公告管理，促进建设生产平稳有 序。强化煤矿关闭退出计划管理，引导企业平稳转型，稳妥做好人 员安置、债务处置、生态修复等工作。健全煤炭产供储销统计体系， 强化能源、安监、税务等部门信息共享和协同监管，加强煤炭生产 监督管理，严厉打击煤矿超产行为，规范煤炭市场秩序

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Actively advance the revision of the Coal Industry Law and improve the coal industry standards (MT) system
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that the revision of the Coal Law will be actively promoted, and the coal industry standard (MT) system improved. Management of coal mining area master plans will be strengthened, with development plans determined by the master plans strictly implemented to improve intensive, efficient resource development. Capacity 'single ledger' management will be enhanced, capacity replacement policies will be adjusted and improved as appropriate, and capacity registration and announcement management strengthened to ensure orderly construction and production. Coal mine closure and exit plan management will be reinforced, guiding companies toward smooth transformation and properly handling personnel resettlement, debt resolution, and ecological restoration. The coal production-supply-storage-sales statistical system will be improved, information sharing and coordinated supervision between energy, safety, and tax departments strengthened, coal production supervision intensified, and overproduction strictly punished to standardize coal market order.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：深入实施“人工智能+”行动 加强煤炭领域人工智能数据归集
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，加快人工智能场景化应用，深入实施“人工智能+”行动，加强煤炭领域人工智能数据归集，推进人工智能在勘探设计、建设生产、运营维护、安全管理等重点场景系统化应用。加快研发推广煤炭领域专用大模型，重点突破智能感知、自主决策、智能控制等关键技术瓶颈，培育建设一批人工智能融合应用试点煤矿，促进煤矿安全生产水平提高。大力实施灾害严重矿井、发生较大及以上事故矿井智能化改造，推动危险繁重岗位机器人作业替代。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Deeply implement the 'AI+' action and strengthen AI data collection in the coal sector
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, Aug 10: The NDRC and NEA issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Coal Industry.' It states that scenario-based application of artificial intelligence will be accelerated, with the 'AI+' action deeply implemented, AI data collection in the coal sector strengthened, and AI applications promoted across key scenarios such as exploration design, construction production, operation and maintenance, and safety management. Development and promotion of specialized large models for the coal sector will be accelerated, with breakthroughs in key technologies such as intelligent perception, autonomous decision-making, and intelligent control. A batch of pilot coal mines for AI integration applications will be cultivated and built to improve coal mine safety. Intelligent transformation of mines with severe disasters or those that have experienced major or above accidents will be vigorously implemented, with robot operations replacing humans in dangerous and labor-intensive positions.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：优化煤炭生产组织 有序释放先进产能
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，持续加强煤炭稳产稳供，优化煤炭生产组织，科学安排采掘接续，有序释放先进产能。研究建立重点产煤省区协同生产机制，推动市场平稳运行。加强供需监测和生产调度，强化电煤保供中长期合同签订履约，高效开展区域互济、多能互补，提升迎峰度夏、迎峰度冬等重点时段顶峰保供能力。稳定“两湖一江”、东北、西南等重点地区煤炭供应，深化煤炭调入区与主产区供需衔接和战略合作，优化储煤基地建设布局，提高电厂存煤水平，突出保障民生用煤需求。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: Optimize coal production organization and release advanced capacity in an orderly manner
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 10 — The National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It states that efforts will continue to strengthen stable coal production and supply, optimize coal production organization, scientifically arrange mining and excavation succession, and orderly release advanced capacity. A coordinated production mechanism for key coal-producing provinces and regions will be studied and established to promote stable market operations. Supply-demand monitoring and production scheduling will be strengthened, medium- and long-term contract signing and performance for thermal coal supply assurance will be reinforced, and regional mutual aid and multi-energy complementarity will be efficiently carried out to enhance peak supply capabilities during periods such as summer peak demand and winter peak demand. Coal supply in key regions including 'Hubei, Hunan, and Jiangxi,' the Northeast, and the Southwest will be stabilized, supply-demand connections and strategic cooperation between coal-importing regions and major producing areas will be deepened, the layout of coal storage base construction will be optimized, coal inventory levels at power plants will be raised, and the demand for coal for residential use will be prominently guaranteed.

headlines.title: 两部门：持续推进现代煤炭市场建设
headlines.summary: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中提到，积极发展全国统一煤炭交易市场，完善基础制度和规则，健全信息共享机制，进一步发挥全国煤炭交易中心作用。完善电煤保供中长期合同制度，推进煤炭交易合同规范化标准化，加强合同签约履约监管。健全煤炭市场价格形成机制，结合市场形势和成本变化适时完善煤炭价格区间调控政策，规范价格指数行为。

headlines.title_en: Two ministries: continue advancing modern coal market development
headlines.summary_en: The NDRC and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It mentions actively developing a unified national coal trading market, improving basic systems and rules, refining information-sharing mechanisms, and further leveraging the role of the National Coal Trading Center. The medium- and long-term contract system for thermal coal supply assurance will be improved, the standardization of coal trading contracts will be promoted, and supervision over contract signing and performance will be strengthened. The coal market price formation mechanism will be improved, coal price range adjustment policies will be refined in a timely manner based on market conditions and cost changes, and price index behavior will be regulated.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：各类型煤矿新增产能要严格执行产能置换政策
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，有序推进接续产能建设，持续推进煤炭资源勘查，强化资源综合评价，提升资源储量规模，保障煤炭接续开发。加强产能总量调控，统筹资源开发潜力、区域供需平衡等因素，合理安排接续产能规模，重点布局在五大供应保障基地内，优先支持上下游一体化产业发展和跨区域煤炭供应保障项目。“十五五”期间，新增产能必须纳入产能“一本账”后组织实施。各类型煤矿新增产能要严格执行产能置换政策

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: all types of coal mines must strictly implement capacity replacement policy for new capacity
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 10 — The NDRC and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It states that the construction of succession capacity will be advanced in an orderly manner, coal resource exploration will be continuously promoted, comprehensive resource evaluation will be strengthened, resource reserve scales will be enhanced, and coal succession development will be ensured. Total capacity control will be strengthened, and factors such as resource development potential and regional supply-demand balance will be comprehensively considered to reasonably arrange the scale of succession capacity, with a focus on deployment within the five major supply assurance bases, and priority support for upstream-downstream integrated industrial development and cross-regional coal supply assurance projects. During the '15th Five-Year Plan' period, new capacity must be included in the capacity 'single ledger' before implementation. New capacity at all types of coal mines must strictly implement capacity replacement policies.

headlines.title: 国家发改委、国家能源局：2030年 五大煤炭供应保障基地产量占全国比重超80%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月10日讯，国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《煤炭工业发展“十五五”规划》。其中指出，统筹资源开发条件、市场需求、运输通道、环境约束等因素，有序推进煤炭资源开发。西部资源富集地区强化开发整体规划，完善上下游开发利用体系，提升跨区域协同保障能力。持续推进山西、蒙西、蒙东、陕北、新疆煤炭供应保障基地建设，高标准规划建设一批大型现代化煤矿，提升规模化集约化开发水平，2030年，五大煤炭供应保障基地产量占全国比重超80%。东中部地区统筹本地区用能需求，合理控制开发节奏，根据资源条件加强评估论证，适度建设接续煤矿。

headlines.title_en: NDRC and NEA: by 2030, output from five major coal supply guarantee bases to account for over 80% of national total
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data, August 10 — The NDRC and the National Energy Administration have issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Coal Industry Development.' It states that coal resource development will be advanced in an orderly manner by coordinating factors such as resource development conditions, market demand, transportation channels, and environmental constraints. Western resource-rich regions will strengthen overall development planning, improve upstream and downstream development and utilization systems, and enhance cross-regional coordinated supply capability. Construction of coal supply assurance bases in Shanxi, Western Inner Mongolia, Eastern Inner Mongolia, Northern Shaanxi, and Xinjiang will be continuously promoted, with a number of large, modern coal mines planned and built to high standards, and the level of large-scale and intensive development improved. By 2030, output from the five major coal supply assurance bases will account for over 80% of the national total. The eastern and central regions will coordinate local energy demand, reasonably control the pace of development, strengthen evaluation and demonstration based on resource conditions, and appropriately build succession coal mines.
